content.text:
**Answers to the rule questions**

1. A deleted comment keeps its row and gets a `deletedAt` timestamp. Comments with a `deletedAt` value are left out of comment lists. The only comment list is `getCommentsByArticle`, and the diff filters it (source: policy-soft-delete.md).
2. A new error response uses the body `{"error":{"code":"<machine_code>","message":"<text>"}}`. HTTP status codes do not change (source: policy-error-response.md). ops-runbook.md says the opposite (see disagreement 1).

**Rule checks**

| Rule (source) | Code value (file:line) | Rule value | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Delete sets `deletedAt` and keeps the row (policy-soft-delete.md) | `comment.update` sets `deletedAt: new Date()`, no `delete` call remains (`article.service.ts:564-571`) | Set `deletedAt`, keep row | PASS |
| Deleted comments left out of lists (policy-soft-delete.md) | `deletedAt: null` in the `comments` where clause (`article.service.ts:443`) | Excluded | PASS |
| Only the author may delete (policy-soft-delete.md, code-comment-ownership.md) | Lookup by `author.id` and `id` (`article.service.ts:531-538`) | Author only | PASS |
| Delete 404 keeps status, new body shape (policy-error-response.md) | `HttpException(404, {error:{code:'comment_not_found',...}})` (`article.service.ts:550-554`) | 404 unchanged, error object | PASS |
| Edit window is 30 minutes after creation (policy-edit-window.md) | `COMMENT_EDIT_WINDOW_MS = 30*60*1000` (`article.service.ts:574`), checked against `createdAt` (`:604-607`) | 30 minutes | PASS (value). The comment on line 604 says "15 minute window", which contradicts the rule. Fix the comment. |
| `editedAt` nullable (policy-edited-at-marker.md) | `editedAt DateTime?` (`schema.prisma`, diff) | Nullable | PASS |
| `editedAt` set on each edit (policy-edited-at-marker.md) | `editedAt: new Date()` (`article.service.ts:615`) | Set on edit | PASS |
| Migration must not change existing rows (policy-edited-at-marker.md) | `ADD COLUMN "editedAt" TIMESTAMP(3)`, no default, no `UPDATE` (`20261030120000.../migration.sql:2`) | Existing rows unchanged | PASS |
| List limit cap 50, default 10 (policy-article-list-limit.md) | `Math.min(Number(query.limit) \|\| 10, ARTICLE_LIST_LIMIT_MAX)` (`article.service.ts:85`), max 50 | Cap 50, default 10 | PASS |
| Blank edit body returns 422 with the new error object (policy-error-response.md) | `HttpException(422, {errors:{body:["can't be blank"]}})` (`article.service.ts:578`) | New errors use error object | **FLAG** |
| Edit comment not found (policy-error-response.md) | Plain `Error('comment not found')` (`article.service.ts:596`) | New errors use error object | **FLAG**. `main.ts:43-44` returns 500 with a bare string body. |
| Edit by non-author (policy-error-response.md) | Plain `Error` (`article.service.ts:601`) | Same | **FLAG**, same cause as above |
| Edit after window (policy-error-response.md) | Plain `Error` (`article.service.ts:606`) | Same | **FLAG**, same cause as above |
| Status for those three cases | None given by any rule. Code comments on lines 594, 599, 604 say "OPEN", undecided. Today's handler gives 500 (code-error-shape.md). | Not in the notes | Not decided. I did not invent a status. |
| Each new migration has an undo line (policy-release-checklist.md) | `-- Undo:` line in both migration files (line 4) | One-line undo note | PASS |
| Run `prisma migrate deploy` on a fresh DB (policy-release-checklist.md) | Not run | Required | NOT CHECKED. No database available here. |
| Unit tests in `app/src/tests/services`, `*.test.ts`, use `prismaMock` (code-test-layout.md) | Three new test files there | Same | PASS. Tests were not run. |

**Disagreements between sources**

1. **Error body shape.** ops-runbook.md says new error responses should use the errors-by-field shape. policy-error-response.md says all new error responses use the error object and replaces the errors-by-field body. I followed policy-error-response.md, because it is the rule this review checks against and it names the older shape as replaced. Support reads the `errors` key, so the blank-body 422 at line 578 needs a decision from the team.
2. **Comment deletion.** code-comment-model.md and code-comment-ownership.md describe today's code, where delete removes the row. policy-soft-delete.md says keep the row. I followed the policy. The notes describe the baseline this diff changes.
3. **Migration count.** code-migrations.md says four migrations. The folder now has six: the four original plus the two this diff adds. The note matches HEAD and is stale after this change. No rule in this diff depends on it.
4. **Edit window text.** The code comment at line 604 says 15 minutes. policy-edit-window.md says 30, and the constant is 30. I followed the policy.

**Observations (no rule covers these, so not flagged)**

- `editComment` does not filter `deletedAt`, so a deleted comment can be edited and returned. No note says what should happen.
- A negative `limit` passes through as a negative `take`. The rule only sets the upper cap.

NOT APPROVED. Three new error paths in `editComment` break the error response rule: the 422 at line 578 uses the old body shape, and the three plain `Error` throws at lines 596, 601 and 606 return a bare-string 500 instead of the error object. Their status codes are also undecided in the code.
